description: Gorynycz, the three-headed dragon of Slavic tales who guards the bridge into the land of the dead, a huge wingless dragon with dark green scales, three long snake-like necks with three horned dragon heads, grey smoke rising from the nostrils, glowing yellow eyes and sharp fangs, a long spiked tail, standing on four clawed legs, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, no wings, no bridge, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture, all three heads whole
